notes.title: 👽 Glitch Blaster's Waifu 👽
notes.content:
[img]https://clan.akamai.steamstatic.com/images/40743330/dd698bd32454144b1c01ea1167724fc4c3467436.gif[/img]

Glitch Blaster's Waifu finally has a Steam page!

From our friends, Osando Studio, creators of two of past releases Hot Tentacles Shooter and Double Shit Gals.

Glitch Blaster's Waifu, is retro-style shoot 'em up adventure!

As an intrepid hacker, you find yourself pitted against a malevolent AI that has kidnapped innocent girls.

Don't wait more and wishlist now!

The game will be releasing sometime Q2 2024!

👽👽👽

[url]https://store.steampowered.com/app/2859600/Glitch_Blasters_Waifu/[/url]
